newsitem.title: USA: Guardsmark wins federal suit vs Borg-Warner.
newsitem.headline: Guardsmark wins federal suit vs Borg-Warner.

text.p: Security services firm Guardsmark Inc said Tuesday a federal court dismissed efforts by rival Borg-Warner Protective Services Corp to strike down a Guardsmark agreement with its security officers.
The agreement kept Guardsmark's officers from being hired by competitors to service former Guardsmark clients, the privately-held company said.
The company said Borg-Warner was ordered to pay court costs. Borg-Warner Protective's parent company, Borg-Warner Security Corp, was not immediately available to comment.

The court ruled Guardsmark contract provisions had been "carefully drawn to minimize" hardships to employees and to prevent competitors from opportunistically appropriating the investment Guardsmark makes in recruiting, screening and development of its security officers, the company said.
